capabilities: Show a table as plain Markdown text while the cursor is inside it
Edit table rows as normal editor lines in Live Preview
Toggle table text via command or hotkey
Pad and align table columns when leaving a table (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a table formatting or export tool; it only changes how Live Preview draws the table the cursor is in.
extras: Freemium: core features free, column alignment and a Pro align command need a $15 one-time or $5/month sponsorship. Relies on non-public Obsidian API parts and disables itself with a notice if they change. After updates it opens a 'What's new' tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat.
intentEvidence: Plain Text Tables brings back plain text table editing in Live Preview.
motivation: The author built it to answer a forum request for a toggle for plaintext table editing in Live Preview.
problem: Since Obsidian 1.5.3, Live Preview always draws tables as a table editor, so editing the raw pipe text requires switching the whole note to Source mode.
summary: Live Preview tweak that shows the Markdown table holding the cursor as plain pipe text and redraws it as a table when the cursor leaves.
